notes: Preserves all Vita Nova Staff 1.0.124 and 1.0.123 workflow fixes.
Filters phone/tablet Event Attendance Add Youth search results to youth identity fields only, so unrelated youth are not returned because of staff/case-manager/program text.
Fixes phone/tablet Event Attendance Add Youth search by moving it to a narrow event-attendance profile search endpoint allowed by the kiosk/staff attendance flow.
Keeps staff-authenticated portal calls carrying the kiosk token so tablet event-attendance routes have the authorization context they need.
Cleans up the Mass Email dialog layout with scrollable content and larger compose/status areas so controls do not get clipped on staff screens.
Auto-merges pending check-ins when there is exactly one active Very High duplicate candidate and both email and phone match, including on verification queue refresh.
Keeps release Java class files compatible with the Java 25 staff runtime.
